description:
After JH-03's sprite got rejected, I decided to republish it properly.

-REUPLOAD-
JH-03, blue robot that came to help Mario in his adventures. Used for my Pufferel '85 game.

She is just a robot(NPC), nothing can forget her.

To add JH-03, you have to use the NPCs v4.2 sprite.

JH-03 created by Puffle Dreemurr.
